workload.task: causal next-item with uniform sampled negatives

feature_bank.scope: One immutable shared asset; not per-user or per-release persistent state

configuration.writer: Unchanged corrected dynamic item-gate trajectory; shadows never write

controls.zero: Zero auxiliary payload; native-only reads on the same dynamic-writer cache
controls.global_mean: Actual fit-only per-layer48 mean on every coded inherited prefix row; current-born suffix zero; native attention/mass preserved

configuration.labels: Output analysis only; no labels in any read or mean preparation

source_reconstruction_sensitivity.scope: Only reconstruction omitted from primary. Required source work already charged is not added twice.

immutable_feature_bank_preparation.cost_owner: Complete serving price includes the once-per-chain shared bank and replica policy; excluded from this per-release fit total to avoid double charging.

preparation.convention: MAC=2; elementary pointwise=1; padded dense shapes charged. Forward arithmetic declared from current adapter. Trainable forward and frozen-backbone backward conservatively estimated2x; no loaded serving timing claim.
preparation.source_extra_scope: Supplied source_extra_* FLOPs join the reconstruction sensitivity or, if source_available=False, the primary cost. Other shared-calibration work is added explicitly at its call site.

mean_preparation.scope: Diagnostic-only preparation; actual fitted64 strict pre-V3 native V2 rows with current V3 item features; no teacher, request labels or evaluation rows; row-weighted per-layer48 mean

bootstrap.resampling: One shared sorted-UID multiset for all methods/metrics, including idle users; equal16-candidate sets for score errors/pair-AUC; pooled candidate AUC

metrics.signs: Positive AUC/pair-AUC differences favor dynamic; negative MSE differences favor dynamic
metrics.reference: Retained once-per-release native Rebuild, not per-request Fresh teacher

source_reconstruction_sensitivity.scope: Only reconstruction omitted from primary. Required source work already charged is not added twice.

immutable_feature_bank_preparation.cost_owner: Complete serving price includes the once-per-chain shared bank and replica policy; excluded from this per-release fit total to avoid double charging.

diagnostic_replay_cost.convention: MAC=2; elementary pointwise=1; padded dense shapes charged. Forward arithmetic declared from current adapter. Trainable forward and frozen-backbone backward conservatively estimated2x; no loaded serving timing claim.
diagnostic_replay_cost.source_extra_scope: Supplied source_extra_* FLOPs join the reconstruction sensitivity or, if source_available=False, the primary cost. Other shared-calibration work is added explicitly at its call site.

cost_scope: Fit-mean preparation and diagnostic replay are separately retained development execution; these control costs are not claimed as serving costs
limitation: Global mean removes row-specific compact payloads, while preserving native/history-dependent attention, code-prefix mass, current query gates and the original corrected writer; no optimal query-only baseline claim
